jobs_results.job_title: Senior Executive – Supply Chain Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
About Us
At Kohler, our mission is to help people live gracious, healthy, and sustainable lives. We believe that empowering our associates is essential to making this vision a reality. That’s why we invest in personal and professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams and functions, and offer a comprehensive wellness package that supports the well-being of every team member.


Kohler is an equal opportunity employer. Along with competitive compensation and benefits, we offer something more enduring—a legacy built on bold innovation, creative excellence, and a deep commitment to our people and communities. Learn more about our culture and career opportunities at www.kohler.co.in/careers.


Our approach to hiring reflects our commitment to Global Inclusion. We recruit, hire, and promote qualified individuals in all roles without regard to race, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, or disability. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you appropriately.



Job Description:


About the position:


We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a global center responsible for providing technical and nontechnical services for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler Co. globally (including Kitchen and Bath, Hospitality). We are on the journey of establishing a center for excellence, responsible for bringing cutting edge solutions with the latest technologies and creating a delivery function for various implementations across functions.


We are looking for a Senior Executive, Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and strengthen our Supply Chain Analytics Organization. This role will play a critical part in building and sustaining the foundational data capabilities required for supply chain network modeling, optimization, and visualization. As a key enabler of the Network Design COE, the analyst will manage data pipelines, automate workflows, and deliver actionable insights through advanced analytics and visualization. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate, learn, and grow within a dynamic global supply chain environment, working closely with the broader analytics team and various Supply Chain COEs





Role and Responsibilities


Data Management & Pipeline Development
Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines to support supply chain network modeling and analytics.
Integrate and transform data from multiple sources including SAP, TMS, WMS, and external datasets using tools like SQL, Python, and Alteryx.
Automate data workflows and ensures accuracy, consistency, and availability for modeling and visualization purposes.
Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams to streamline data ingestion and transformation processes.



Data Analysis, Coding, and Visualization
Perform exploratory and statistical data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and insights across the supply chain.
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau to support decision-making.
Use Python for data wrangling, automation, and advanced analytics tasks such as forecasting, clustering, or optimization support.
Leverage Excel (including VBA scripting) and Power Query for quick-turnaround analysis, prototyping, and ad hoc reporting.
Prepare and validate datasets for use in supply chain network modeling tools (e.g., Llamasoft, Optilogic)



Collaboration & Support
Work closely with the Network Design COE team to provide data-driven support for strategic initiatives.
Partner with Advanced Analytics, Procurement, Logistics, and Finance teams to align data requirements and outputs.
Assist in the development of standardized data models, templates, and reusable scripts for recurring analyses.



Process Improvement & Documentation
Identify opportunities to streamline data processes and improve data quality and accessibility.
Document data sources, transformation logic, automation scripts, and reporting standards to ensure transparency and repeatability.
Contribute to the development of best practices for data governance, coding standards, and analytics within the supply chain function.



What we are looking for from your past experience


Experience requirement:


Must Have’s
5–7 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within a supply chain or operations environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, automation, and analytics.
Experience with data transformation tools such as Alteryx or similar ETL platforms.
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
Proficiency in Excel, including advanced formulas and VBA scripting for automation.
Familiarity with supply chain concepts such as sourcing, inventory, transportation, and capacity planning.
Experience working with large datasets from ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and integrating data from multiple sources.
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and a passion for solving complex problems with data.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly and effectively.
Added Advantage
Exposure to supply chain network modeling tools (e.g., Llamasoft, Optilogic) is a plus.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Fabric) is an advantage.
Knowledge of data governance and master data management principles.
Work experience
7+ Years of overall experience in Supply Chain/ Data Analysis and/or related field
Educational Qualification requirement:


Degree in Engineering, Data Analysis, Operations Research, Data Science or similar


Organizational Relationships:


Reports to Senior Manager – Supply Chain Operations & Design
Regular interactions with Global Supply Chain and Operations teams
Frequent interaction with Internal stakeholders including SC Leadership teams
Other Details:


The associate should have the flexibility to work in shifts to accommodate an overlap with US Stakeholders timings.




Mandatory Skills:
Supply Chain Analyst, Data Specialist, Power BI, Python, SQL, Data Analytics


Location:
Pune, Maharashtra, India


Experience:
5 to 8 years

validation.Utilize advanced SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis from various relational databases, data warehouses, and Big Data platforms.Develop and maintain data visualization dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView, translating complex data into understandable business insights.Lead the analysis of complex data sets to identify trends, Job Title: Data Analyst – Off-Campus Hiring 2026





Location: Pune – Hybrid  





Employment Type: Full-time | Batch: 2025 & 2026 Graduates









About the Opportunity



We are excited to announce our Off-Campus Hiring Drive for 2025 & 2026 batches!
If you are a recent graduate or in your final year and passionate about uncovering insights from data, this is your chance to launch your career as a Data Analyst with a high-growth, innovation-driven organization.





You will join a collaborative analytics team that partners with product, marketing, finance, and operations to deliver data-driven solutions that directly impact business decisions.

Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from multiple sources.



Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations using Tableau / Power BI / Looker.



Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), identify trends, and present actionable insights.



Design and evaluate A/B tests, perform statistical analysis, and generate predictive reports.



Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into analytical models.



Ensure data quality, accuracy, and security across pipelines and reporting layers.



Document findings and communicate recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Understanding of statistics, probability, and hypothesis testing.



Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.



Strong written and verbal communication in English.

Experience or academic projects with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

Exposure to machine learning basics or product analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel).



Internship or project experience in data analytics, BI, or related field.








Why Join Us




Be part of a next-generation analytics team driving strategic decisions.



Access to mentorship and training from senior data scientists and business leaders.



Competitive salary with performance bonuses.

How to Apply



Apply now through the LinkedIn or directly at company careers page link
For any queries, Call us on 02269711557 with the subject “Data Analyst – Off-Campus”.

Data Science and Data Analyst Trainer:-


ARC Technologies & Institutions


Job Summary:-


ARC Technologies & Institutions, an IT EdTech organization focused on technology training, skill development, and industry-oriented projects, is looking for a Data Science and Data Analyst with strong expertise in Data Analytics, Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Power BI, and Advanced Excel.


The trainer will be responsible for delivering structured and engaging technical training, conducting practical sessions, bootcamps, revision sessions, assessments, and project-based learning activities, while also contributing to data analytics and industry-oriented projects.


Key Responsibilities
Training & Student Engagement

Conduct engaging and interactive regular training classes on Data Analytics, Data Science, Python, SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, and Machine Learning.
Conduct technical bootcamps, workshops, practice sessions, revision sessions, doubt-clearing sessions, and interview preparation sessions.
Design and deliver hands-on learning activities using real-world datasets, projects, case studies, and industry use cases.
Engage students through discussions, demonstrations, assignments, coding exercises, practical tasks, and project-based learning.
Conduct assessments, mock tests, practical evaluations, and skill-based assessments to track student progress.
Provide constructive feedback and identify areas requiring improvement.
Mentor students during their academic and industry-oriented projects.
Support students with technical interview preparation and practical problem-solving.
Maintain an engaging classroom environment and ensure effective participation from learners.
Adapt training methodologies according to different student skill levels.

Data Analytics & Project Responsibilities

Analyze, interpret, and visualize structured and unstructured datasets.
Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), and validation.
Develop interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI and Advanced Excel.
Write, optimize, and manage SQL queries for data extraction and analysis.
Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to real-world business and analytical problems.
Develop, test, and evaluate predictive models.
Work with Python libraries including NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Scikit-learn.
Prepare MIS, analytical, and management reports.
Work on industry-oriented projects and convert data into meaningful business insights.
Utilize Generative AI, AI tools, and Prompt Engineering to enhance training, analytics, and productivity.

Training Content & Internal Responsibilities

Contribute to the development and improvement of training materials, presentations, assignments, practice exercises, and project content.
Assist in planning training schedules, bootcamps, revision modules, and assessment activities.
Collaborate with the internal academic and placement teams to align training with industry requirements.
Keep training content updated with current industry practices, tools, technologies, and job requirements.
Participate in internal knowledge-sharing sessions and trainer development activities.
Maintain student performance records and provide regular feedback to the concerned team.

Python | SQL | Advanced Excel | Power BI | Data Analysis | Statistics | Machine Learning | NumPy | Pandas | Data Visualization | EDA | MIS Reporting | Generative AI | Prompt Engineering | Training & Presentation Skills | Excellent Communication Skills

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Good understanding of Data Analytics and Data Science concepts.
Strong classroom training, presentation, and communication skills.
